name: enhancement
description: A PBI that adds or improves value for users

name: bug
description: Fixes something that does not work as expected

name: documentation
description: Adds or reorganizes documentation, including instructions for AI agents. Does not change product behavior

name: devex
description: Developer experience: improvements to development and operations that users cannot see

name: needs-refinement
description: Refinement not finished. Starting now risks rework

name: wontfix
description: Decided not to do. Leave the reason in a comment and close

name: sprint
description: An issue for a Sprint: its Sprint Goal, Review, and Retrospective

name: product-goal
description: An issue for a Product Goal: the long-term objective spanning Sprints
